items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I studied jazz piano with Lloyd Reese... A teacher Reese can't help but be an influence.

ctx.x: You know? Although our teachers were the ones that sent us out there with experience. After I did it a couple of times, I said, 'What is Lloyd Reese getting paid for this?' And Phil Moore hasn't got great yet for film scores. And I know he did four scores for them. I don't mean everything, but 20 minutes to a half an hour of music.
Well, it's still the practice that goes on.
